name: Frequency-Decoupled Guidance (2-level Laplacian)
plain: Splits positive and negative x0 predictions into a two-level Laplacian pyramid and applies a higher scale to fine detail and the normal cfg to coarse. Rebuilds the image afterward.
math:
Levels i=0 (high), 1 (low); w₀ = strength_high, w₁ = cfg.
For each level: d = c_i − u_i; x_i = c_i + (w_i−1)·d
x̂ = pyrup(x₁) + x₀.
Latents are padded to a power of 2 if needed.
label: from code
surprise: It calls project, then adds the two parts straight back, so the projection is a no-op (fdg_nodes.py). There is no parallel weight in this version.
